it will never torch a weaker foe.

life energy within its body steadily builds
to reach uncontrollable levels.

examples have been discovered. Kabuto

tails to make itself look bigger.

entries.english:
Its arrival brings an end to the winter.

gives rise to the budding of fresh life
across the land.

entries.english:
OAK: Hm…
How disappointing…\pIf you win, you earn prize money,
and your POKéMON grow.\pBut if you lose, {B_PLAYER_NAME}, you end
up paying prize money…\pHowever, since you had no warning
this time, I'll pay for you.\pBut things won't be this way once
you step outside these doors.\pThat's why you must strengthen your
POKéMON by battling wild POKéMON.\p
entries.chinese:
大木博士：嗯……
真是遗憾啊……\p如果你赢了，就能获得零用钱，
宝可梦也会成长。\p但如果你输了，{B_PLAYER_NAME}，你就要
支付给对方零用钱……\p不过，既然这次事发突然，
我就替你付了吧。\p但只要你走出这扇大门，
可就没这么走运了。\p所以你必须通过与野生宝可梦对战，
来提升你宝可梦的实力。\p
